top_signals.title: Cramer bets AI spending will 'continue apace,' says he's not giving up on data center trade
top_signals.summary: CNBC's Jim Cramer said he doesn't see AI spending slowing, despite growing concerns about the pace of model development.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: JPMorgan says Clarity Act ‘not fully dead,’ but passage window ‘extremely narrow’
top_signals.summary: The Clarity Act is "not fully dead," but the window for passing the crypto bill this year is now "extremely narrow," JPMorgan said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
